storyBlocks.sourceHtml: It was early to mid August now, and we were back.

storyBlocks.sourceHtml: This is always one of our favorite times of the year, because every August we have our family reunion just a few miles away. It is always a fun time. All my sisters and their extended families camp at a nearby campground all weekend and part of the week. Our kids and grandkids camp that weekend too, the oldest ones at the campground, and sometimes our youngest at our cabin.
